# Hello!

My name is Olivia Vruwink (pronounced 'vroo-wink'). I am a speech-language pathologist and PhD candidate in Speech-Language-Hearing Sciences at the University of Minnesota. I am studying various aspects of rehabilitation after traumatic brain injury (TBI) under the supervision of [Dr. Natalie Covington](https://cla.umn.edu/about/directory/profile/nvcoving). My research interests include purpose in life in TBI survivors and their care partners, with a focus on how it may contribute to overall well-being and rehabilitation outcomes. I am also interested in the scholarship of teaching and learning (SoTL) in the field of communication sciences and disorders. I aim to obtain a tenure-track faculty position with a mix of research and teaching/clinical responsibilities.

Welcome to my personal website. Many thanks to Samantha Csik for her spectacular [tutorial](https://ucsb-meds.github.io/creating-quarto-websites/).
